statement: For the exact-class proper Hilbert incidence W_H -> H attached to a fixed signed rational central witness, prove either smoothness at a useful source point or directly that the actual image contains a nonempty open/top-dimensional subset of the chosen irreducible Hodge branch. Tangent surjectivity at an unverified singular point is inadmissible as a substitute.
falsifier: Exhibit a source-specific reason that every exact-class Hilbert component through the central witness has lower-dimensional/vertical image in H, or prove singularities prevent any smooth point relevant to the branch.
